tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje rgod tshang pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i zab 'grel bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍā ki ni sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ sku gsum lhun grub thams cad mkhyen par ldan pa'i dpal// dmigs med thugs rjes brtse ba chen po yis// 'gro ba bu bzhin gzigs nas dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs// ma rig mun par gnas pa'i sems can long ba rnams// mkhyen gnyis spyan gyis thar lam 'khrid mkhan mchog /chos rje rin po che la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba rgod tshang pa 'di yang skye ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas shing*/ gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa smin cing grol ba'i lam la bkod pa'i sangs rgyas yin par 'dug kyang*/ skye ba 'dir gdul bya'i snang ngo dang bstun nas/ sprul pa'i sku 'jig rten 'dir byon/ rje rin po che la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyis sbyang rgyu med kyang*/ gang zag rim skyes pa rnams kyi blo rim gyis drangs zhing brod pa skye bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ log shes can rnams kyi 'khrul pa sel bar mdzad pa dang*/ rtogs shing nyams su myong ba rnams kyi ngo sprod par mdzad cing nges shes skyed pa dang*/ rjes 'jug ma 'ongs pa rnams la snang bar mdzad pa'i don du/ rje rin po che yang lam rim gyis sbyang pa ltar skye tshul bstan par gda'o// de la bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku bkod pa rin po che de/ mthong ba tsam gyis ba spu g.yo zhing*/ bltas pa tsam gyis zag pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ba/ dbang po la yul gzhan gyis bskyod mi nus pa de/ 'tshogs pa rnams la zhal bstan/ gsung tshangs dbyangs kyi sgra rin po che de thos pa tsam gyis dang ba 'dren cing*/ brjod pa tsam gyis yid tshim par byed pa de la/ thugs chos nyid rin po che de 'gag med rig pa'i gdangs la mkhyen pa sna tshogs shar ba de/

gsung tshangs dbyangs rin po che'i sgra la skyod nas/ chos dang gdul bya'i dbang po brda 'phrod par mdzad pa'i phyir/ ljags pad+ma rin po che ni bsgyur/ tshig skye med rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis/ gzhan rgyud blo gros pad+mo kha ni phye/ rmongs pa rnams kyi the tshom gyi mun pa sel bar mdzad cing*/ thar pa'i lam rin po che ston par mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ rje sgam po bas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi la/ rje phag mo grub pas gsum gsum du phye nas bcu gnyis su mdzad 'dug ste/ bshad pa mdzad pa ni mi 'dug ste/ nga yis go ba 'di ltar blangs gsungs/ de yang rtse gcig la gsum las/ rtse gcig dang po ngo bo mi rtog par gnas pa de yin/ 'bring po gnas pa de brtan par song ba de yin/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin de sbyangs pa'i dwangs cha la/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ston nus pa 'byung*/ zag bcas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ste/ de la lam dang bstun na 'jig rten pa'i lam yin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i dbang du byas na rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bya ba yin/ rtse gcig gi mnyam rjes gnas mi gnas yin/ phyir rtse gcig rjes rang yin/ de yang kho rang gi dbang du byas na/ bde gsal mi rtog par gnas pa de mnyam bzhag /de la mi gnas na rjes rang yin gsung*/ rje'i zhal nas/ nga la dang po rtog pa gcig pur song nas rtse gcig nyams de skye ma myong ste/ skal ldan kun bla ma rtogs ldan la gsol ba btab pas/ nyams skye long ma byung bar rtogs pa shar ba yin/ da lta nga'i 'di na yang rtse gcig gi nyams de chen po med gsung*/ spros bral la gsum las/ spros bral dang po sems skye 'gags dang bral bar rtogs pa bya ba de yin/ gong gi ting nge 'dzin de rtogs pa'i sgrib byed du yod pa yin/

des gang la sgrib na gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ngo la sgrib pa yin/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams zhig nas/ tha mal gyi shes par khres kyi song ba dang*/ tha mal gyi shes pa rang ga ma 'di/ gzhi rtsa med par lhang gis rtogs pa de la/ dang po 'di nas skyes bya ba mi 'dug /'di ru 'gags bya ba mi 'dug /'di na gnas bya ba mi 'dug pas/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs bya/ phal mo che 'bru de ltar gnon pa yin te/ ngas 'di bzhin byas te 'di rang bde bar 'dug gsung*/ de yang snang ba sna tshogs su 'char gyi 'dug pa de 'gag med du 'dug /shar yang kho rang gi rang bzhin skye ba med par 'dug pas skye med du 'dug /de'i thog na tha mal rang rgyud pa mi gnas par 'dug /de la dang po spros bral dang po skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs zer ba de yin gsung*/ yang rje'i zhal nas/ nga la 'di'i skabs su 'di ltar byung gsung*/ dang po rje rin po che'i drung na yar la phyin/ nyi ma gcig rang la rje rin po che dang mjal/ de nas zhag shas nas nged btsun pa bdun cu tsam la khrid btab cig tu mdzad kyi 'dug /rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ thams cad bla ma la gsol ba thob la/ sems ma bcos par rang sor zhog /rang rang gi phug par song la bsgoms shig gsung*/ der dang po tsa na nga'i bsam pa la/ bsgom bya ba 'di da ltar gyi rtog pa 'gags pa la zer ba yin snyam pa gcig byung*/ der de la blo rtse gtad cing bsgom pas/ rtog pa ye 'gag tu ma gtub ste/ rtog pa la yang pha rgad po mon grags bya ba de krong krong shar byung*/ der de med pa gcig 'dod cing ji ltar byas shing bsgoms/ rtog pa ye 'gag tu ma gtub ste/ rtog pa la rgad po mon grags sngar bas kyang gsal bar sngo krong krong shar byung gsung*/ de nas sang yan chad khong pa kun/ khar sang che ge mo'i btsun gsar la bsgom skyes zer/ ma ge mo'i btsun gsar la bsgom skyes zer gyin song*/

der nga'i bsam pa la khong pa kun nyams re dga' na/ nga pha gi ba tsho la rtogs pa mi skye ba 'ong ngo snyam pa byung*/ de nas zhag shas na nged kha gcig min pa thams cad la bsgom skyes zer gyi 'dug pas/ der nyi ma gcig gi bsam pa la khong pa tsho thams cad la bsgom skyes zer gyi 'dug pas/ nga la mi skye ba wa dmar po bsam pa gcig byung*/ der de nub kyang spyil po gog po gcig tu phyin/ bla ma la gsol ba drag po btab nas/ shes pa tshar chod pa'i rten 'brel mang po byas nas/ de ka tsug gsol ba btab pas/ nam phyed yol tsa na thang chad nas 'gyel nas song*/ de nas gnyid gcig sad nas 'dug bltas pas/ sems 'dzin pa med par phyal le gnas kyi 'dug /der bsgom bya ba de 'di la zer ba yin nam snyam pa bkra hrig pa gcig byung*/ de nas de kha tsug bsgoms pas/ yang rtog pa la sngar gyi pha rgad po mon grags krong shar byung*/ de kho rang la bltas pas gzhi med skye ba med pa 'dra ba gcig 'dug /sang rin po che'i drung na yar phyin pas/ lho pa bsgom skyes se gsung*/ bsgom ma skyes lags/ rnam rtog la rang bzhin med pa 'dra ba gcig gda' ste byas/ da rung ci 'dra gcig 'dug ltos la shog /khyod kyi sngar chos 'dra ba nyan ne gsungs nas ngo sprod du ma 'dod/ de tsa na ngo sprod pas chog tsam yod pas gsung*/ do red yang mdangs kyi skyil po gog po der phyin/ bla ma la gsol ba btab nas bsgoms pas/ rtog pa la sngar gyi pha rgad po mon grags krong shar byung*/ der kho rang la ltas pas/ kho rang rang bzhin skye ba med pa gcig tu 'dug ste/ de rjes la rang bzhin med pa yin na rnam rtog tu 'char ba mi 'thad/ rang bzhin med pa 'char na nam mkha' 'char ram snyam pa gcig byung*/ de ka la shes pa dkrug thom tser song*/ nga las med kyi ngas de'i shan yang ma phyed pa yin gsung*/ yang rin po che'i drung na yar phyin pas/ lho pa bsgom skyes se gsung*/

bsgom ka ma skyes lags zhus pas/ 'dir shog dang ci 'dra gcig byung gsung*/ der rtog pa rang bzhin med pa 'dra ba gcig gda' ste/ rang bzhin med pa yin na/ rnam rtog tu 'char mi 'thad/ rang bzhin med pa 'char na/ nam mkha' 'di yang 'char ram snyam pa gcig byung zhus pas/ rin po che zhal la phyag bkab nas dar gcig bzhad kyin 'dug /de'i phyi nub nam mkha' stong pa bya ba yin/ nang gi sems rig stong dbye ba med pa bya ba yin pas/ rang bzhin med pa kho nas 'char ba yin mod gsung*/ der de ka la bkra hrig byung nas bde phyam song*/ der sngar gyi pha rgad po mon grags kyi snang ba 'gag tu ma 'dod pa de/ chu nang gi zla ba'am nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin wal le ma 'gags par 'dug /rang bzhin med pa bya ba de/ bsgom chen pa phal mo che stong pa phyang chad gcig la blo rtse gtad nas 'dug ste ma go ba yin/ rang bzhin med pa bya ba de/ yul stong par 'gro ba la zer ba min/ a 'thas kyi rang bzhin med pa la zer ba yin/ 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin med pa yin/ yang des las sna tshogs su 'char gyin 'dug pas 'gag med du 'dug /shar yang kho rang gi rang bzhin skye ba med par 'dug pas skye med du 'dug /de'i thog na tha mal rang rgyud par mi 'dug pas gnas pa mi 'dug /de la ngas chos skad du spros bral 'bring po rnam rtog rang bzhin med pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs pa bya ba yin gsung*/ rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi khyad par rnam rtog chos skur grol ma grol yin/ rtse gcig 'jig rten pa'i lam yin/ rnam rtog chos skur grol ba de/ spos bral ngo bo mthong ba zer/ sems skyed kyi dbang du song ba yin na/ don dam byang chub mchog tu sems skyed pa zer/ dbang bzhi'i skad du byas na dbang bzhi pa thob pa zer/ mtshan nyid pa mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ngos zin pa yin gsung*/ 'o na de la ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/

sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal blta nus pa dang*/ sprul pa mi 'dra ba brgya brgya 'gyed nus pa la sogs pa yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis ston nus pa de yod dam zhe na/ nga yod par 'dod pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin brgya mtshon pa tsam yin/ de'i dus na ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la snyoms par zhugs nas yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mtshon pa tsam yin/ bla ma jo bo thugs rje chen por bsgom tsa na/ bla ma thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ba yin/ de bzhin sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhal blta bar nus te/ de khyed mtshan nyid pa'i blo khog tu mi shong*/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis po de/ rtogs ldan gcig gi rang snang yin/ gang zag gzhan dang mthun snang du byung ba ma yin/ sprul pa yang de dang 'dra bar bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston nus gsung*/ 'bring po rtsa ba dang bral bar rtogs bya ba de/ gong gi nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa gzhi rtsa med par lhang gis rtogs pa la/ nges pa'i shes pa a pa 'khor bar 'khyam par byed pa'i gzhi nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa la/ gzhi rtsa med 'dug pa la snyam pa'i shes pa dga' ba khyad par can skyes te/ nges shes de rang bzang rtog tu song yod pa yin/ de ngos zin nas bzang rtog gzhi rtsa med par lhang gis rtogs pa la/ 'bring rtsa ba dang bral bar rtogs pa zer ba yin/ yang na nges shes de rang chos nyid rang gsal du rtogs na yang*/ rtsa ba dang bral bar rtogs pa yang dka' ste 'dug /nga la bsgom deng tsam yod tsa na/ rin po che sku gshegs nas med gsung*/ rab phyi nang gi sgro 'dogs chod pa bya ba de/ spros bral 'bring po na/ nang nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad gzhi rtsa med par rtogs kyang*/ da rung phyi rol gyi yul la ji ltar byas kyang*/ 'khrig ma tshud par yod pa yin/ nga la dang po phyi rol gyi yul snang thams cad rang sems su shes/ sems snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/

nang nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa/ phyi tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad rang gi sems su shes/ sems snang la rang bzhin med pa/ yul dmigs gtad dang bral ba/ nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur bde phyam gyis rtogs pa de la phyi nang gi sgro 'dogs chod pa zer ba yin/ rje'i zhal nas/ 'di'i skabs su nga la 'di ltar byung gsung*/ rin po che pa sku gshegs pa'i mya ngan du/ lho brag mkhar chur bsgrub pa byed kyin yod tsa na/ nyi ma gcig gi tshe phye phad la byi bas rmugs nas 'dug /der dang po tshig pa za 'khrug pa gcig byung der rjes snying rje dungs pa gcig bsgoms pas snying rje ka re 'dug /bla ma dang jo bo thugs rje chen por bsgoms pas kyang de ltar shar byung*/ der snang ba rang gi sems bya ba de la zer bar 'dug snyam pa bkra rig pa gcig byung*/ de nas kho rang gi thog tu ma bcos par bzhag pas kho rang gi rang bzhin skye ba med par 'dug /skye ba med par 'dug kyang*/ snang ba 'gag tu ma gtub ste/ chu nang gi zla ba 'am nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar wal le 'dug /dmigs pa dang bral ba bya ba de/ stong pa yul du dmigs gtad dang bral ba de/ snang ba ma 'gags par 'dug /rtog pa yul du dmigs gtad dang bral ba de/ snang ba'i rang bzhin skye ba med par 'dug /'dzin pa med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur 'dug /nyams len phyi nang med par bde bar 'dug pas/ de la chos skad spros bral chen po snang ba rang gi sems su shes/ sems snang la rang bzhin med pa/ yul dmigs gtad dang bral ba/ nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur rtogs pa bya ba yin/ nga bsgom de tsam gcig yod tsa na rgya gar dza lan dha ra la sogs bskor ba yin gsung*/ de tsa na ngas bsgom chen pa kun la/ snang ba 'di thams cad rang gi sems su 'dug /sems ni snang la rang bzhin med par 'dug /de las lhag pa'i bsgom yod de byas kyin dris pas/ shan phyed pa tsam ma byung gsung*/

spros bral gyi mnyam rjes dran mi dran yin/ dran na mnyam bzhag ma dran na rjes/ spros pa dang bral ba la/ 'khor 'das kyi bar na dran mi dran las med pas/ gdam ngag gi rtsa ba dran pa yin/ nyin bar rkyen gyis mi gnod na spros bral chen po yin/ rtogs pa rtsal rdzogs pa la/ rkyen gyis mi gnod zhes tha snyad btags pa yin/ de nas ro gcig tu na 'phar ba la tshegs mi 'dug gsung*/ ro gcig 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres bya ba de/ snang ba la bden par bzung bas 'khor ba zer ba yin/ de'i rang bzhin skye ba med par shes pa la/ mya ngan las 'das pa zer ba yin/ der snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med par rtogs pa la/ ro gcig 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres pa zer ba yin/ ro gcig snang ba bsgom du shar/ khor yug ma ru song ba yin bya ba de/ bsgom ro gcig gi rtogs pa shar nas/ nyams myong phal mo che khor yug tu 'gro /gang zag rigs ma nges pas/ nub mo mi 'ong pa yang srid/ la la rmi lam 'gag zer te/ rmi lam gyi snang ba mi 'gag par 'dod/ da ltar gyi snang ba 'di 'gag gam/ rtsa chad rang sa zin pa dang*/ 'dzin med rang so tshugs pa la/ yang dag pa'i dran pas zin pa zer ba yin/ sems ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pas/ cir yang 'char la/ shar ba'i dus su ji ltar shar yang*/ kho rang ngo bo nyid kyis stong par rtogs pa de*/ snang 'dzin dang stong 'dzin mi 'dug pas/ blo 'das zer/ snang dmigs dang stong dmigs mi 'dug pas/ dmigs gtan dang bral pa zer/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug /bden gnyis dbyer med/ 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres pa zer ba yin/ rje'i zhal nas/ nga la 'di'i skabs su 'di byung gsung*/ dang po rang ro gcig yin nam snyam pa byung*/ 'bri khung pa'i sgom chen 'dra ba la dris pas/ shan phyed pa ma byung*/ de ro gcig min par 'dug /phyis tsa ri na gtor ma gcig btang ba'i rjes la/ shes rab snying po gcig 'don gyin yod tsa na/

gzugs stong ba'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so zer ba la/ a pa gzugs rang stong par 'dug pa/ stong pa nyid gzugs su 'dug pa la snyam bkra rig pa gcig byung*/ de'i rjes la gang ltar shar ba'i snang ba thams cad dran pas tshur bzung ma dgos par/ snang ba thams cad kho rang ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa/ 'dzin med du zang thal thal 'dug /de la dran 'dzin rtsol ba med pa la/ dran med phyal par ma shor ba/ nang 'dzin med rang so tshugs pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa/ rtsol med ma yengs tsam/ thug phrad rang ngo shes pa la/ yang dag pa'i dran pa zer ba yin/ de nas bsgom ma yengs pa'i ngang du 'dzin pa med par glod nas ci dgar bzhag pas/ ci zhig ltar na nyams myong gnas cha med par song*/ sngar gyi bag chags thams cad bkra rig rig shar nas byung*/ snang ba thams cad kho rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong par 'dug /stong par 'dug kyang snang ba 'gag tu ma gtub ste/ bag chags kyi snang ba de thams cad sngar gyi sems gzugs su go bas/ de nas rgyu 'bras kyi 'gros rags pa thams cad shes pa byung*/ bsgom ro gcig gi rtogs pa shar nas/ rgyu 'bras rags rim gcig cis kyang 'char nges par 'dug gsung*/ spros bral dang ro gcig gi khyad par/ spros bral snang ba rang gi sems su shes/ ro gcig snang ba bsgom du shar/ 'o na sems su shes pa dang bsgom du shar ba la khyad ci yod na/ stong thog tu stob mi stob gcig yod/ spros bral stong thog tu tshur stob pa gcig yod/ de dag pa ro gcig tu song ba yin/ ro gcig yan chad la rtogs pa'i ngo bo na 'phar rgyu med/ myong ba brtan du song bas khyad par du che ba yin/ myong ba brtan du song bas kyang spang bya re spangs nas yong ba yin te/ ngo bo la ni 'phar rgyu med pa yin gsung*/ spros bral ba dang ro gcig gi khyad par rgyas par phye na/ 'di spros bral chen po'i skye tshul yin te/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems snang la rang bzhin med par/

yul dmigs gtad dang bral ba/ nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu bde khyab kyis rtogs/ de ltar rtogs kyang da rung yul snang stong zung 'jug la 'phrig ma tshud par yod/ yul snang stong du shar ba dang*/ yul snang la rang bzhin med par bde bar yod/ stong thog tu tshur stob pa gcig yod pa yin/ sems kyi rang bzhin skye ba med par rtogs pa las/ gnas lugs rtogs pa min/ chos skad stong pa'i kha 'dzin che bar yod/ rang bzhin med pa zer/ ma grub pa zer/ ma skyes pa zer/ gzhi rtsa med pa zer te/ rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod nyen yod pa yin/ stong pa phyogs gcig rtogs pa gnas lugs min/ yul la dngos por zhen na'ang gnas lugs rtogs pa min/ spros bral rtogs pas kyang gnas lugs rtogs pa min/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rang bzhin gyi med par rtogs kyang*/ snang ba thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las byung ba yin te/ rdo rje gsang lam ma'i na bza' la gzigs nas/ 'di'i mtshan nyid ma shes pas/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma shar ba yin/ spros bral dus su rgyu 'bras stong nyid du bzhugs pa yin/ ro gcig dus su stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ba yin/ de gnyis kyi khyad par de yin gsung*/ spyir sems la gsum yin gsung*/ ngo bo/ mtshan nyid/ gnas lugs bya ba gsum yin/ ngo bo bya ba thams cad rang gi sems su shes/ sems snang la rang bzhin med pa/ bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa de yin/ de'i gdangs 'gag pa med pa snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba la/ sems kyi mtshan nyid zer ba yin/ snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med par rtogs pa la/ gnas lugs rtogs pa zer ba yin/ rje'i zhal nas/ 'o skol tsho sems kyi mtshan nyid mi gcig pas/ 'di tsam gcig la 'dra ba gcig kyang mi gda' na/ de tsho thams cad sems kyi mtshan nyid 'char sgo tha dad mi gcig pa las byung ba yin te/ sems gzugs krong krong ba snang ba/ rang gi sems gzugs las byung ba yin te/

snang ba de thams cad ngo bo rang bzhin gyis dag pa/ snang ba dang stong pa dbye ba med pas rtogs pa gnas lugs rtogs pa zer ba yin/ dge sdig gi snang ba thams cad sems gzugs su go bas/ rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba nas 'dor len shes te/ skyon dag cing yon tan rtogs pa'i rten 'brel sgrig shes/ gang shar ba'i snang ba thams cad sems gzugs su krong shar/ rgyu 'bras rags rims shar ba yin gsung*/ 'bring gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chad bya ba de/ 'dzin pa tshogs drug gi yul la skye ba yin/ yul snang shar ba dang 'dzin pa stong pa dus gcig tu 'byung bas/ 'bring bzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chad zer ba yin/ gang ltar shar ba'i snang ba thams cad sems gzugs su krong krong shar/ snang ba de kho rang ngo bo nyid stong par 'dug /stong par 'dug kyang snang ba 'gag tu ma gtub ste/ sgyu ma ltar wal le 'dug pas/ gnyis med zung 'jug tu rtogs pa yin/ dran 'dzin rtsol ba med pa/ yang dag gi dran pa las ma g.yos pa/ ma bzung la ma shor ba/ ma byas la lhun gyis grub pa bya ba de tsho don gcig pa yin gsung*/ rab snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i ngang du zhi ba bya ba de/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i rang bzhin skye ba med par ni spros bral rang nas rtogs la/ 'dir ro gcig 'bring po na rjes bden 'dzin phra mo yod las che/ 'dir gnyis 'dzin thams cad skye med kyi ngang du zhi ba zhes bya/ 'o na bsgom med dang khyad ci yod zhe na/ da rung rjes sgyu ma lta bu yod/ spyir mnyam bzhag /rjes shes/ rjes la thob par bya ba gsum yod/ rjes la bzhi las/ rjes shes nyon mongs pa/ rjes shes rtog pa/ rjes rtog pa phra mo/ rjes sgyu ma bya ba yin/ rjes nyon mongs pa bya ba de spros bral la dran pas ma zin na nyon mongs rab skye nyen che/ rjes rtog pa bya ba de/ rtog pa skad cig ma tol skye/

rtog pa phra mo bya ba de rtog pa phra mo skye/ sgyu ma bya ba de sgyu ma phra mo skye ba yin/ de rnams thams cad bsgom bya yin/ bsgom byed la ched du 'dzin pa la ma zhugs pas/ de blo 'das su gnas/ rtsol ba med pa/ yang dag gi dran rgyun srings pas/ rjes je phra 'dag pa yin gsung*/ bsgom med dang po bsgom bya bsgom byed dang bral ba bya ba de/ chos spyi ltos nas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sngon la sbyangs/ shes bya'i sgrib pa mjug la spor bar gsungs/ chos rje ras pa rgyu zad spun zad dus gcig la 'dzad par bzhed/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa mjug la spong gsungs te/ khong gi de la mi 'thad pa mi 'dug gsung*/ ngas bsgom med dang po bsgom byed dang bral ba de la go ba 'di ltar du blangs so// ro gcig na rjes sgyu ma lta bu yod/ bla ma zhang gi zhal nas/ ro gcig a 'thas yad yud tsam gsung*/ ro gcig chen po na a 'thas dang nam yang med de/ nga nyin par rjes rang med dam snyam/ rjes de nub mo gnyid du song*/ rmi lam ma byung ba nas rjes bzung 'dzin rags pa yang ma skye/ chos nyid rang gsal du yang ma song la/ rjes sgyu ma lta bu gcig yod de/ sgom bya yin/ de 'dzin med rang gsal du dran tsa na/ yang dag gi dran pa phra mo de bsgom byed yin/ de la rtag par bsgom pa mi 'dug /chad par bsgom par mi 'dug /blo mi 'dug pas mi bsgom par yong ba yin/ dran pa de dag pa dang bsgom med du song ba yin/ bsgom med chung ngu na gong gi rjes sgyu ma tsam de yang phra mor song ba'i sgyu ma phra mo gcig yod/ de la dran pa rten mi dgos/ kho rang rang dag la 'gro /de mtsho nang gi 'khyags pa dang 'dra gsung*/ ro gcig dang bsgom med kyi khyad par/ rtsol med kyi dran pa dag ma dag yin/ bsgom gyi ngo bo la ni ro gcig yan la na 'phar rgyu med/

dran pa de dag pa dang bsgom med zer ba yin/ rje'i zhal nas/ nga'i go ba de tsho thams cad thad so thad so na tig pa yod pa yin gsung*/ nga 'di na mar la spar tshod byed pa yin/ 'bring lhun grub kyi rang sa tsir gyis zin bya ba de yang*/ yang rig rtsol bral gnas lugs rang rig rtogs pa'i ye shes la zer/ rang rig rtogs pa'i ye shes rjes snang sgyu ma tsam du yang mi 'pho la/ 'gyur pa med pa la rang sa zin pa zer/ 'o na bsgom med chen po dang khyad ci yod zhe na/ da rung 'di na rjes mi rtog ngo ma shes bya ba yod dam snyam/ rab 'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres bya ba de/ slob dpon mtshan nyid pa kun/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma zhes kyang bya/ shes bya'i sgrib pa zhes kyang bya de phra mo gcig yod zer/ ci 'dra gcig yod byed kyang phra mo gcig yod zer ba min pa 'dzug gu 'dzug sa mi 'dug /ngas phar tshod byas na/ bsgom med 'bring po na yod pa'i gnas ngan len gyi dri ma zhes kyang bya/ shes bya'i sgrib pa zhes bya ba de/ rjes mi rtog pa ngo ma shes gnyis snang phra mo gcig yod dam snyam/ dpe spros bral la nyin mo bsgom yod kyang*/ nub mo med pa gcig gnyid du song*/ rmi lam ma byung gi bar na mi rtog rang gsal du ma song ba gcig yod/ de 'dra phra mo gcig yod dam snyam/ spyir spros bral la ngo bo mthong nas rjes sgyu ma shes bya sbyong ba rang yin/ 'di na rjes nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog nam yang med de/ rjes sgyu ma tsam yang med/ mi rtog rang gsal du ma shar ba/ rjes snang sgyu ma tsam gcig yod dam snyam/ spyir yang shes bya zhes bya ba de gang du ngos 'dzin na/ nang rnam par shes pa'i phyi'i yul du shar ba la shes bya zer ba yin/ yul snang de la shes bya'i yul zer ba yin/ de la chags sdang sna tshogs su spyad pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ shes bya'i sgrib pa zhes bya ba de/

yul snang de mi rtog ngo shes dus thung pa se gol gcig rnams sgyu ma lta bu/ ngo bo mi rtog par gsal du ma shar ba/ rjes gnyis snang phra mo gcig yod dam snyam mo// des gang sgrib na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sgrib/ de gang gis 'dag par bzhed na/ mtshan nyid pa pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dag par bzhed/ gsang sngags pas dbang bzhi pa bskur nas 'dag par gsungs so// nga bla ma'i mos gus dungs pa gcig gi 'dag par 'dod pa yin/ mos gus de blos byas su mi 'gro 'am zhe na/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la blos byas dang blo 'das kyi tha snyad med de/ rtsal ma 'gags pa'i mos gus dung dung des shes bya'i sgrib pa 'dag pa yin/ sgrib gnyis dag pa'i skad cig la/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab 'gyur/ ces gsungs pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bkra rig der 'char ba yin/ rab 'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa zhes bya ba/ bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thob pa'o// gsang sngags nas bcu bzhi gsungs pa ste/ sa bcu gcig yan chad spang bya ni spang rgyu med/ yon tan gyi thob bya la dgos pa 'dra gsung*/ rje'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bya ba de/ mkhyen ni thams cad mkhyen la/ dus gcig la mkhyen par ni mi 'dod/ chos spyi ltos dang nga'i 'di an gcig 'gal ba gcig yod/ yin ni nga'i 'di yin pa 'dra/ de ni gang zag gcig gi rgyud la nyon mongs pa brgya tham pa dus gcig la skye ru btub la/ gnyen po brgya tham pa dus gcig tu gtong du btub na/ mkhyen pa brgya tham pa dus gcig la 'char ba las 'os med kyi/ sems gcig las med pa'i gnad kas/ nyon mongs dus gcig la skye ru ni mi gtub/ ngas mkhyen ni thams cad mkhyen la/ dus gcig la mkhyen par ni mi 'dod/ thams cad thad ka thad kar mkhyen par 'dod pa yin gsung*/

kha gcig na re/ gang zag brgya tham pa dus gcig la 'dul dgos ba tsug 'dul zer bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ bla ma de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ gang zag las sad pa gnyis 'dzom nas/ so so rang rang snang ngor bla ma de'i sku re byon nas smin par byed pa yin gsung*/ nga sprul sku'i 'gro don bya ba de 'dra gcig la 'dod pa yin/ dngos su sprul pa re re 'byung bar mi 'dod/ dpe nam mkha' la nyi zla gcig las med kyang*/ snod chu dang ral gri la sogs pa mang po bkram na/ de rnams kyi nang du re re 'byung ba yin gsung*/ rje'i zhal nas/ nga'i nyams myong 'di shi rim ko rim pa yin pas/ gang zag rim skyes pa 'khrid pa la mkhas pa yin/ gang zag rim skyes pa la thad ka thad kar chos 'di 'dra ba gcig ston shes dgos pa yin/ nga la khyed tsho re che ba yin pas/ gzab nas bshad pa yin no gsung*/ rje rgod tshang pas rnal 'byor bzhi'i zab 'brel mdzad pa lags so// phyag rgya chen po rnal 'byor bzhi'i gter mdzod*/// /
